label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
definition: Organization or business unit X is a subsidiary, organizational part, division or owned business of parent organization Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the earlier subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit owned-by, unit, part or subsidiary evidence qualifies. Geography, ordinary employment and partial investment alone do not. A location standing for an unnamed office would remain ambiguous.

facts.reason: ABC is explicitly a Walt Disney unit/part/subsidiary and owned by it.
Fallon Worldwide is explicitly a Publicis part/unit and owned by it.
NBC is explicitly a General Electric Company unit/part and owned by it; the parent construction agrees.
Foote is a unit and part of True North Communications and is owned by it.
Young & Rubicam is a WPP unit/part and owned by it; acquisition context is additional evidence.
